caveats.plain: This is a forecast, so the days ahead are predictions and will change. It was last updated at the time shown above.
caveats.technical: Open-Meteo forecast, refreshed when the pipeline runs; no ensemble spread or prediction intervals are shown.

caveats.plain: Being live does not make it more accurate. Which neighbourhoods run hotter is measured from satellite images; how much of that reaches the air is still a published average.
caveats.technical: Which zones are hotter is measured from satellite surface temperature; the surface-to-air coefficient alpha remains assumed. Live input changes currency, not validation.

caveats.plain: We could not get neighbourhood-level data on who lives where, so the risk map reflects how hot a place is, not how vulnerable its residents are.
caveats.technical: Vulnerability is a declared placeholder and does not vary between neighbourhoods.

caveats.plain: The health-risk numbers are not based on real hospital or death records from this city.
caveats.technical: Exposure-response coefficients are not fitted to local health data.

caveats.plain: The Hindi and Gujarati warning text has not been checked by a native speaker.
caveats.technical: Advisory copy is machine-composed and unverified.

exposure_response.source: literature-shaped default; not fitted to local data
